tools.name: unit_economics
tools.description: Calculates customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), the LTV to CAC ratio and CAC payback in months from spend, new customers, revenue per customer, gross margin and churn.

acquisition_spend.description: Total sales and marketing spend for the period, in currency units.

new_customers.description: New paying customers acquired in the same period.

monthly_revenue_per_customer.description: Average revenue per customer per month (ARPU), in currency units.

gross_margin_pct.description: Gross margin as a percentage, for example 70.

monthly_churn_pct.description: Share of customers lost per month as a percentage, for example 3.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: growth_rate
tools.description: Calculates total growth and compound growth per period between a start and end value, for example month on month, quarter on quarter or year on year (CAGR).

start_value.description: Value at the start, for example revenue or users.

periods.description: Number of periods between start and end, for example 12.

tools.name: roas_check
tools.description: Calculates return on ad spend from ad revenue and ad spend, and the break-even ROAS implied by gross margin, then says whether the campaign covers its product cost.

ad_revenue.description: Revenue attributed to the ads, in currency units.

ad_spend.description: Ad spend for the same period, in currency units.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: ad_budget_planner
tools.description: Estimates the monthly ad budget needed to reach a target number of new customers from cost per click, landing page conversion rate and lead to customer rate.

cost_per_click.description: Expected average cost per click, in currency units.

click_to_lead_pct.description: Share of clicks that become leads, as a percentage.

lead_to_customer_pct.description: Share of leads that become customers, as a percentage.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: find_growth_moves
tools.description: Returns documented 2026 growth moves by Indian companies from upGrowth's Growth Moves research (January to September 2026), filtered by sector, company or keyword. Each move includes the leader, date and a link to the original source.

sector.description: Sector to search. Use any to search all sectors.

company.description: Optional company name to match, for example Razorpay.

keyword.description: Optional keyword to match in the move description, for example acquisition, UPI or AI agents.

tools.name: max_affordable_cac
tools.description: Works back from customer lifetime value to the most a business can pay to acquire a customer (and, optionally, a lead) while keeping a target LTV to CAC ratio, 3:1 by default.

monthly_revenue_per_customer.description: Average revenue per customer per month (ARPU), in currency units.

monthly_churn_pct.description: Share of customers lost per month as a percentage.

target_ltv_to_cac.description: Target LTV to CAC ratio, for example 3 for 3:1.

lead_to_customer_pct.description: Optional. Share of leads that become customers, to work out the maximum cost per lead.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: period_change
tools.description: Calculates the simple percentage change between 2 values, such as year over year (YoY), month over month (MoM), quarter over quarter or week over week, including sales or revenue growth and percentage increase or decrease.

comparison.description: Which comparison this is, used only for labelling.

tools.name: seo_roi
tools.description: Estimates the monthly return on an SEO investment from extra organic visits, conversion rate, value per conversion and monthly SEO cost, plus the break-even traffic gain.

monthly_organic_visits_gain.description: Extra organic visits per month expected from SEO.

conversion_rate_pct.description: Share of visits that convert, as a percentage.

value_per_conversion.description: Average revenue per conversion (order value or deal value), in currency units.

monthly_seo_cost.description: Monthly SEO spend, in currency units.

gross_margin_pct.description: Optional gross margin as a percentage. Leave out to measure on revenue.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: ai_crawler_access_check
tools.description: Reads a website's public robots.txt and llms.txt and reports whether AI crawlers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity and Google (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) are allowed, restricted or blocked.

domain.description: Public domain to check, for example example.com.

tools.name: mdr_charges
tools.description: Calculates merchant discount rate (MDR) charges on card or payment gateway sales: the MDR fee, GST on that fee, total cost, effective rate and net settlement. Uses the MDR % the user gives; it does not look up provider rates.

sales_value.description: Total value of the transactions, in currency units.

mdr_pct.description: MDR or TDR charged by the provider, as a percentage, for example 1.8.

transactions.description: Optional. Number of transactions, needed only with a fixed fee per transaction.

fixed_fee_per_transaction.description: Optional fixed fee per transaction, in currency units.

gst_pct.description: GST charged on the MDR fee, as a percentage.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: robots_txt_generator
tools.description: Writes a robots.txt file that allows or blocks AI crawlers by purpose: model training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended), AI search (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) and user-triggered fetches (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User), plus paths to keep private and a sitemap. Never blocks Googlebot.

ai_training.description: Whether AI model training crawlers may crawl the site.

ai_search.description: Whether AI search crawlers may crawl the site.

ai_user_fetch.description: Whether assistants may fetch pages when a user asks about them.

disallow_paths.description: Optional paths to keep out of all crawlers, each starting with /, for example /wp-admin/.

sitemap_url.description: Optional full sitemap URL, for example https://example.com/sitemap.xml.

tools.name: schema_generator
tools.description: Builds valid schema.org JSON-LD for a page: FAQ, local business, organization, article or blog post, product, person or breadcrumb. Checks the properties Google lists as required for that type (per Google Search Central structured data docs, developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data) and returns a ready-to-paste script tag.

data.description: Fields for that type. faq: questions [{question, answer}]. local_business: name, business_type (for example Dentist), address {street, locality, region, postal_code, country}, telephone, url, image, price_range, geo {latitude, longitude}, opening_hours [{days: [Monday...], opens: "09:00", closes: "18:00"}]. organization: name, organization_type, url, logo, description, legal_name, founding_date, email, telephone, same_as [urls], address. article: headline, article_type (Article, BlogPosting or NewsArticle), url, images [urls], date_published, date_modified, authors [{name, url, job_title}], publisher {name, logo}. product: name, description, images, brand, sku, price, currency, availability (InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, SoldOut), price_valid_until, rating_value, review_count. person: name, url, job_title, works_for, image, description, same_as. breadcrumb: items [{name, url}].

tools.name: content_seo_check
tools.description: Analyses text the user pastes: word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, approximate Flesch reading ease, long sentences and paragraphs, headings found, and focus keyword count, density and placement. Counts exactly, which assistants often get wrong.

text.description: The article or page text, plain text, Markdown or HTML. Up to 60,000 characters.

tools.name: meta_tags_builder
tools.description: Builds the HTML head tags for a page: title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, with character counts and truncation warnings.

tools.name: youtube_earnings
tools.description: Estimates YouTube ad earnings from monthly views and the RPM from YouTube Studio (or CPM, monetized playback % and the 55% long-form creator share), plus watch hours against the YouTube Partner Program threshold.

monthly_views.description: Views per month on long-form videos.

rpm.description: Revenue per 1,000 views from YouTube Studio, in currency units. Use this or cpm.

cpm.description: Ad CPM, in currency units. Needs monetized_playback_pct.

monetized_playback_pct.description: Share of views that show an ad, as a percentage.

avg_view_duration_minutes.description: Optional average view duration in minutes, to work out watch hours.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: instagram_earnings
tools.description: Estimates monthly and yearly Instagram brand-deal income from the rates the user charges per post, per story or per 1,000 followers, and the cost per engagement a brand pays.

posts_per_month.description: Sponsored posts or reels per month.

rate_per_post.description: Fee per sponsored post, in currency units. Use this or rate_per_1000_followers.

rate_per_1000_followers.description: Fee per post per 1,000 followers, in currency units.

avg_engagements_per_post.description: Optional average likes plus comments plus saves plus shares per post.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: engagement_rate
tools.description: Calculates social media engagement rate for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn or any platform from likes, comments, shares and saves, by followers, reach, impressions or views.

posts.description: Number of posts the totals cover.

tools.name: website_ad_revenue
tools.description: Estimates display ad revenue for a website or blog from monthly pageviews and page RPM, or from ad impressions per page, CPM and fill rate.

page_rpm.description: Earnings per 1,000 pageviews (from AdSense reports), in currency units. Use this or cpm.

ads_per_page.description: Ad units per page, used with cpm.

cpm.description: Earnings per 1,000 ad impressions, in currency units.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: ytd_growth
tools.description: Compares year-to-date totals with the same period last year, from monthly values or YTD totals, and gives a simple full-year run rate.

this_year_monthly.description: This year's values by month so far, January first (or first month of the financial year).

last_year_monthly.description: Last year's values for the same months.

last_ytd_total.description: Alternative: last year's total for the same period.

months_elapsed.description: Months covered, needed with totals for the run rate.

tools.name: ppc_forecast
tools.description: Forecasts a paid search or social budget: clicks, conversions, cost per acquisition, revenue, ROAS, profit after ad spend and break-even CPA, from budget, CPC and conversion rate.

gross_margin_pct.description: Optional gross margin for profit and break-even CPA.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: customer_lifetime_value
tools.description: Calculates customer lifetime value for repeat-purchase businesses such as D2C and ecommerce from average order value, purchases per year, lifespan and margin, with optional discounting and LTV to CAC.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: ecommerce_metrics
tools.description: Calculates average order value, conversion rate, revenue per visitor and orders per customer, and the sessions needed to hit a revenue target.

sessions.description: Optional sessions or visitors in the same period.

target_revenue.description: Optional revenue goal for the same period length.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: growth_projection
tools.description: Projects a value forward at a compound growth rate per period (exponential growth), shows each period, the doubling time and how long it takes to reach a target.

growth_rate_pct.description: Growth per period as a percentage; negative for decline.

tools.name: acos_check
tools.description: Calculates Amazon advertising cost of sales (ACoS), ROAS, break-even ACoS from margin, profit after ads, and TACoS against total sales.

total_sales.description: Optional total sales including organic, for TACoS.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: share_of_voice
tools.description: Calculates share of voice for a brand against competitors on any metric: AI assistant citations or mentions, search impressions, ad impressions, social mentions or press coverage.

metric.description: What was counted, for example ChatGPT citations or impressions.

tools.name: break_even
tools.description: Calculates break-even units and revenue from fixed costs, price and variable cost per unit, the contribution margin, and units needed for a target profit.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: campaign_roi
tools.description: Calculates ROI for a marketing campaign or channel (content, email, events, influencer, recruitment marketing) on revenue and on gross profit.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

tools.name: attrition_rate
tools.description: Calculates employee attrition or customer churn rate for a period from separations and headcount at the start and end, with a simple annualised rate.

separations.description: People or customers who left in the period.

tools.name: book_strategy_call
tools.description: Returns the link to book a free 30-minute growth strategy call with upGrowth. Use only when the user asks to speak with upGrowth.
